DOCUMENT CONTROL · PACKAGES 0 AND A TO E · STATUS DERIVED
1. Nothing is issued as engineering that has not been
engineered. Class D is generated from geometry.py and is
ours to issue. Class L is layout and coordination only,
sized and certified by others. Class X cannot be produced
2. So the structural package carries foundation layouts on
the real grid and column coordinates, and no
reinforcement; the services package carries coordination
3. Status is derived at build time from the issued set, never
typed. A row naming a sheet nobody draws, or a document
nobody writes, fails the checks rather than printing here.
4. Five levels, 6 structural slabs: the slab at +13.20 is the
penthouse floor and the roof over the third floor at once.
5. Deliverable codes are the client's. Where one resolves to
sheets already issued, the existing number is the cross
reference — the agreed set is not renumbered. The prefix
is part of the number: A-402 is the street elevation and
ARC-402 the second floor's ceiling plan, and they are
6. The exterior is settled: scheme A, adopted at P18. Blocked
rows now wait on the measured survey and the plot's soil
figures, neither of which can be settled from the
7. For the owner's own record, costing and construction
information. Not a tender issue, and not for construction.
Document control — every status on this sheet is derived at build time from the issued set.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P17 2026-10-07 ARC-000 deliverables list; title corrected to five storeys
P18 2026-10-07 scheme A adopted: serpentine balcony on every plan; site named
P19 2026-10-07 serpentine waist deepened 0.75 to 1.35 m; 15.7 m² of balcony a floor
P20 2026-10-07 internal partitions 100 mm red brick, specified by the client
